item.title: Capitals re-sign Bogdan Trineyev to two-year, $1.8 million contract
item.description: The Washington Capitals announced Saturday afternoon that they re-signed forward Bogdan Trineyev to a two-year, $1.8 million contract. The first year of Trineyev’s new contract will be a two-way deal ($850K/$225K), while the second year will be a one-way contract ($950K).
